title: The Lamp (ብርሃን)
author: Melat
logline: Ethiopia built wonders when it honoured those who built and learned. What happens to a nation when it stops honouring them?
style_block: painted storybook illustration, warm ochre and gold palette, soft film grain, hand-painted texture, gentle lamplight, no text, no realistic faces

reference.symbol: small brass oil lamp and open leather-bound book
reference.prompt: a small brass oil lamp beside an open leather-bound book on a wooden table, centred, plain background, character and style reference sheet

music.caption: slow cinematic underscore, Ethiopian pentatonic feel, soft plucked krar and strings, kebero drum, warm and reflective, gentle texture, no strong lead melody

shots.reason: Establish greatness (Lalibela) and introduce the lamp symbol
shots.image_prompt: Dawn over a rock-hewn church carved down into red stone, a hand in the foreground lights a small brass oil lamp
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in, lamp flame flickers gently, soft mist drifting

narration.am: በድንጋይ ውስጥ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን ቀርጸን ነበር።
narration.en: Long ago, we carved churches out of stone.

shots.music_cue: soft entrance, solo drone and light strings

shots.reason: Show that learning was honoured: scribes copying books
shots.image_prompt: Scribes in white shawls copying manuscripts by lamplight, an open leather-bound book and the brass lamp on the table
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera, lamp light shimmers, a hand turns a page slowly
shots.music_cue: warm gentle texture, soft kebero rhythm enters

shots.reason: Strength: the victory at Adwa, 1896, shown symbolically
shots.image_prompt: A crowd on a hillside at sunrise with banners and raised hands, no recognisable faces, the brass lamp raised high at the front
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan left to right, banners ripple in wind

narration.am: አድዋ ላይ ቆመናል፤ ዓለምም ቀና ብሎ ተመለከተን።
narration.en: We stood at Adwa, and the world looked up.

shots.reason: Modernity: knowledge handed to a new generation
shots.image_prompt: A teacher hands the brass lamp and open book to a young student in a 1950s Addis Ababa courtyard, a small aeroplane in the sky
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle push-in, aeroplane drifts across the sky

narration.am: ዩኒቨርሲቲ ከፍተን፣ አውሮፕላኖችን ወደ ሰማይ አስነሳን።
narration.en: We opened a university and sent planes into the sky.

shots.music_cue: peak of warmth, theme at its fullest

shots.reason: Turning point: the light begins to fail
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the brass lamp, flame small and trembling, colours around it turning grey
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in, flame flickers weakly, colour drains slowly

narration.en: Because we honoured those who learned, we built.

shots.music_cue: music thins, a held note turns minor

shots.reason: What was lost: an emptied classroom in 1974
shots.image_prompt: An empty classroom with rows of desks, dust in grey light from a window, the book left open on a desk, muted colours
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera, dust floats in the light shaft

narration.am: ከዚያ 1966 ዓ.ም. መጣ። ክፍሎች ባዷቸውን ቀሩ።

shots.music_cue: sparse, low strings, silence between notes

shots.reason: Educated people forced to leave or be silent
shots.image_prompt: At night a teacher silhouette packs the book into an old suitcase beside a dim lamp, long shadows
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in, shadow moves across the wall

narration.en: Teachers packed their books and left in the dark.

shots.reason: Consequence: hardship, told without blaming a group
shots.image_prompt: Dry cracked land under a grey sky, a lone empty path, faded colours
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across the landscape, wind blowing dust

narration.am: ብዙ መገንባት የሚችሉ ዝም ተባሉ፣ ወይም ተሰደዱ። ምድሪቱም ጸጥ አለች።
narration.en: Many who could have built were silenced, or gone. And the land grew quiet.

shots.reason: Hope returns: a student finds the old lamp
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a young student's hands lifting the old brass lamp and book from a dusty desk, a thin line of warm light
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in, dust lifts, warm light grows

narration.am: ግን አንድ ተማሪ አሁንም መብራቱን ያገኛል።
narration.en: But somewhere, a student still finds the lamp.

shots.reason: The question lands, then the AI end card
shots.image_prompt: A student lights the lamp in a small room, dawn light fills the window, colour returns, warm gold
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in, flame steadies, light brightens, fade to end card

narration.am: እንደገና ብናበራውስ? የሚያስቡትን፣ የሚያስተምሩትንና የሚገነቡትን ብናከብራቸውስ?
narration.en: What if we lit it again? What if we valued those who think, teach and build?

shots.music_cue: full theme returns, resolves and fades
